title: I built a free world history map you can scrub through 5,000 years
description:
Try it: https://historymapworld.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=scrub

Drag the timeline from 3400 BC to today and watch the borders redraw. Click any of the 602 events on the map to read what happened. Works in 8 languages and on your phone.

Also inside: 80 war maps (front by front), plague maps, religion maps and 153 inventions.

Borders: Cliopatria (Seshat Global History Databank), CC BY 4.0
Event summaries: Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0
